sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject

sinks.name: TEE_CreatePersistentObject

sinks.reason: read to obtain bytes to move; may contain sensitive data

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData

sinks.name: TEE_ReadObjectData

sinks.name: TEE_SeekObjectData
sinks.reason: seeking changes which object data will be read/written next, affecting access to potentially sensitive persistent object contents
sinks.role: object handle whose data stream is repositioned

sinks.name: TEE_SeekObjectData
sinks.reason: controls position within sensitive object data, influencing subsequent reads/writes

sinks.name: TEE_SeekObjectData

sinks.name: TEE_WriteObjectData

sinks.name: strlen
sinks.reason: reads memory contents sequentially until a NUL terminator; processes potentially attacker-controlled data and can overread if unterminated
